detail.longDescription:
Icedrive gives you everything you need to store, protect and enjoy your photos, videos, music and documents in the cloud.

Create an account and get 10GB of cloud storage on us—no referrals or hoops to jump through. Automatically back up your camera, access important files offline and keep everything available across your devices.

Features:

• Automatically back up photos and videos
• Upload and download with reliable background transfers
• Stream videos and music directly from the cloud
• Create and organise audio playlists
• Preview images, PDFs, documents, spreadsheets, presentations, code and fonts
• Cast supported videos to your TV
• Keep selected files available offline
• Access Icedrive through the iOS Files app and Share extension
• Share files and folders or create public links
• Request files directly into your folders
• View previous file versions and recover deleted items
• Protect the app with a PIN, Face ID or Touch ID
• Secure sensitive files with client-side, zero-knowledge encrypted storage
• Choose from light and dark themes
• Available in 10 languages  

Need more space? Premium plans offer up to 5TB of cloud storage.

Store more. Share easily. Stream instantly. Keep your files protected with Icedrive.
